title: Laredo police: Loud boom was SpaceX returning into Earth's atmosphere
excerpt: A loud boom rattled houses across Laredo on Saturday, Nov. 14.
content:
LAREDO, Tex. (KGNS) - 4:08 p.m. update: A loud boom heard across Laredo on Saturday, Nov. 14, was SpaceX returning into Earth’s atmosphere, according to preliminary information from Laredo police.

Police said the South Texas corridor is part of the trajectory for the return of the space flight. They said the sonic boom was heard throughout many South Texas communities, including Laredo.

What was reported

A loud boom rattled houses across Laredo on Saturday, Nov. 14.

People across the city reported hearing it around 3:20 p.m.

Laredo police said they are flying drones over the area to look for a possible source. No one has said what caused the noise.

KGNS has contacted police and the fire department and will provide updates as they are received.

Laredo police released a statement on social media regarding the sound:

The Laredo Police has received numerous calls regarding a loud boom heard throughout the entire community. Many of us heard the sound also.

At this point there is no direct source or emergency that has been identified at this point. We are actively investigating our assigned areas and drones are canvassing the area to make sure that everything is alright.

There is no immediate danger and the lines to 911 are being tied up with calls about the “sound”. We respectfully ask that you not congest 911 lines regarding the loud sound. Other medical or emergency calls won’t be able to get through if everyone ties up our 911 lines about the sound.

We appreciate your assistance with this. If we have any updates we will post them here and keep you updated with the latest vetted information. Thank you.
